response.why: 6 lands + one sweeper is too slow and has no early interaction. Against Green Stompy I need 3-5 lands with cheap removal (Lay Down Arms or Get Lost). Day of Judgment at turn 4 cannot stop their turn-2 creatures.

Bury a basic Plains. I already have 3 Plains + Fountainport (4 land sources), which is plenty. Keep Enduring Innocence (recurring value), Steadfast Sentinel (vigilance attacker), and Fountainport (utility).

No removal spells. Control needs 3-5 lands + at least one cheap removal (Lay Down Arms or Get Lost), per mulligan guide. Against Green Stompy, zero interaction means I get overrun by turn 2-3 creatures. Keep looking for a hand with early answers.
Bury a Plains. I have 4 lands + Get Lost (premium removal) + 2 Sentinels. Too many basic lands for control; 3 Plains + Fountainport-equivalent is enough. Keep Get Lost to answer their first threat.

Bury a Steadfast Sentinel. Keep 3 Plains + Get Lost + 1 Sentinel. Perfect control curve: mana for early removal, creature for board presence. Having 2 Sentinels is redundant when I need the lands to stay.
